desc: Fix permanently skipped tests in test_server.py
context: app/tests/test_server.py has 5 tests permanently skipped due to "AsyncMock causes recursion issues with FastAPI serialization" (evidence: skip-01). These cover critical auth middleware behavior. Investigate the root cause: the AsyncMock recursion happens because FastAPI tries to serialize the mock during response construction. Fix approaches: (1) Use httpx AsyncClient with a real (but test-configured) app instance instead of TestClient + AsyncMock, or (2) Use patch at the middleware level rather than mocking the serialization path. Read test_server.py fully before attempting a fix. Remove @pytest.mark.skip decorators once tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 tests in test_server.py run without skip
cd app && poetry run pytest tests/test_server.py -v passes completely
